title: Arrays, Strings, Hashing, Prefix Sums
thesis: Turn linear scans into O(1) lookups: hashing and prefix sums are the bedrock every later pattern builds on.

title: Two Pointers & Sliding Window
thesis: Collapse nested loops into a single moving window — the mindset behind most array and string interview questions.

title: Stacks & Monotonic Stack
thesis: Keep a stack sorted to answer 'next greater / smaller' in one pass — the key to histogram and span problems.

title: Linked Lists & Design
thesis: Pointer surgery and cache design: reverse, detect cycles, and build an O(1) LRU from a hashmap plus a doubly-linked list.

title: Trees & BST
thesis: Recursion over structure — traversals, invariants, and the ordered guarantees of a binary search tree.

title: Heaps & Intervals
thesis: Keep the top-k live with a heap, and reason about overlaps by sorting intervals on the right key.

title: Tries & Backtracking
thesis: Prefix trees for word problems, and disciplined backtracking that prunes the search space instead of brute-forcing it.

title: Graphs & Topological Sort
thesis: Model dependencies as a graph; BFS/DFS, cycle detection, and topological order unlock scheduling problems like Course Schedule.

title: Shortest Paths
thesis: Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford, and BFS-on-weights — pick the right shortest-path tool for the constraints you're given.

title: Dynamic Programming I
thesis: Find the recurrence, then remember it: 1-D DP over choices, from Coin Change to classic knapsack shapes.

title: Dynamic Programming II
thesis: 2-D and interval DP — grids, subsequences, and partitions where the state needs two dimensions.

title: Greedy & Bit Manipulation
thesis: Prove the local choice is globally optimal, and wield bit tricks for set-state and constant-space wins.

title: Mixed sets + first mocks
thesis: Interleave patterns under time pressure and take your first scored mocks; target ≥ 24 / 35.

title: Timed company sets
thesis: Company-style problem sets on the clock — build speed and pattern recall; target ≥ 28 / 35.

title: Mock intensives
thesis: Back-to-back full mocks under real conditions; tighten communication and edge-case coverage; target ≥ 30 / 35.

title: Final rounds & retro
thesis: Simulate final onsite rounds, close mistake-journal loops, and retro your weak areas — interview-ready.
